lines.2: 「What's wrong? Why'd you suddenly get serious?」
lines.3: 「There was someone by the entrance to the mountain just now!」
lines.4: I looked where Konoe was pointing.
lines.6: 「I definitely saw someone a second ago.」
lines.7: 「Someone? We're the only two on this island.」
lines.12: She handed me a fallen tree branch.
lines.13: 「You were sure enough about what you saw to think I'd need a weapon?」
lines.15: 「Fine. Wait here and keep an eye on your surroundings.」
lines.17: 「I'm only going to take a look.」
lines.18: A guy couldn't exactly chicken out now.
lines.19: Truth was, I felt a little uneasy, but I marched ahead anyway.
lines.20: 「He's really dependable at times like this...」
lines.26: Konoe came over to join me.
lines.27: 「...That's strange. I'm sure I saw someone.」
lines.29: 「I think they were taller than you.」
lines.33: 「Possibility number one: Konoe picked up and ate a dangerous mushroom, and now she's hallucinating.」
lines.34: 「What am I, a dog!? I don't eat random stuff off the ground!」
lines.35: 「Possibility two: a willow-tree ghost. You were so nervous that you mistook a tree for a person.」
lines.37: 「...To be clear, I only mean I'm not nervous because someone I know is here.」
lines.38: 「Possibility three: Konoe is trying to scare me.」
lines.39: 「If I were going to do that, I'd make it much more elaborate.」
lines.42: 「Why am I always the cause!? Can't you think of anything else?」
lines.43: 「You're the one insisting you saw someone. I can't help it.」
lines.44: 「Continuing. Possibility four: Konoe made it up as an excuse to cling to me.」
lines.45: 「Think of something that could actually happen!」
lines.46: She gave me a light kick.
lines.52: 「Fine... If I look for a cause besides you...」
lines.54: 「W-what? What do you think it could be?」
lines.55: 「This is a deserted island... the perfect place to hide from people.」
lines.56: 「Could it be some criminal wanted on the mainland?」
lines.61: It looked as though someone had pushed their way through the grass.
lines.65: 「...Still, one of the island's animals could've made this.」
lines.67: 「To be absolutely safe, let's stick together until our ride comes.」
lines.69: 「Hey, I can handle some random guy. Relax.」
lines.71: 「If something does jump out, I'll fight it with you!」
lines.73: Konoe raised her wooden stick and darted into position beside me.
lines.78: I was sure she'd go "Eek!" or something.
lines.79: Instead, she took up a fighting stance!
lines.80: For someone with no martial arts training, she was awfully dependable.
lines.82: 「We'll get cold standing around in this breezy spot.」
lines.83: 「Let's warm up in the hot spring.」
lines.84: 「Yeah, that might be a good idea.」
